description: Check website training started with start_website_training: crawl status, pages found and trained, and how many training sources the workspace has. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

training_session_id.description: training_session_id from start_website_training. Omit for the latest one.

name: get_training_status
title: Get website training status
